note: Mitchell County Conservation Board's 10.6-acre park on the Cedar River, 1.5 mi S of St. Ansgar: non-designated sites on shaded lawn along the riverbank, with a swim beach, boat ramps and docks, and a handicap-accessible fishing pier. --Claude
summary: Confirmed ~50 non-designated sites, 50-amp + water, showers, flush toilets, dump, self-register FCFS, early May-mid Oct. Fees added $20 (undated). Riverfront stands on the county's own photos. Pin ~370 m off in a farm field: move to 43.3541,-92.9234.
flags: PIN ~370 m off: stored 43.35080,-92.92300 is in a crop field south of the park. The riverside camping lawn is at about 43.3541,-92.9234 (Esri; Google's park pin 43.35358,-92.92380 is ~70 m south of it in the trees). Suggest 43.3541,-92.9234.

WATERFRONT riverfront stands: the Cedar here is ~90 m wide. Off-season imagery shows no rigs, but the county's own photos (halv1-halv3 on mitchellcountyconservation.com) show travel trailers and a tent parked on open mowed lawn at the riverbank, on the river side of the park road, with nothing between them and the water but a strip of bank grass. The swim beach is a separate spot along the same bank; it was not seen between the pictured rigs and the water.
FEES undated: MyCountyParks gives '$20/night' with no year (no stored rate before).
BOOKING: the county website's 'Book Campsite' link goes to MyCountyParks, but only Cedar Bridge Park's campsites are bookable there; Halvorson is self-register.
Google 4.5 from 78 reviews; phone (641) 732-5204 matches. Website confirmed.
